details: Recent intensified military exchanges between the United States and Iran, including US airstrikes and Iran's retaliatory closure of the critical Strait of Hormuz, have significantly destabilized global financial market sentiment. This escalation has prompted investors to adopt a "risk-off" posture, leading to capital outflows from speculative assets such as Bitcoin and broader equity markets, in favor of traditional safe-haven instruments. While diplomatic efforts are underway by Qatar, Oman, and Pakistan, the ongoing threat to maritime transit and energy infrastructure is expected to maintain high market volatility. Bitcoin's price has remained choppy, trading around $62,800, reflecting this indecision and a daily decline of approximately 0.65% as of July 13, 2026. This period of uncertainty is largely tied to concerns over regional stability.
title: Geopolitical Tensions Escalate Between US and Iran, Fueling Risk-Off Sentiment in Crypto Markets
